source_relationships.observation: On selection change, group captures direct active/animating body transforms at line 266 before it schedules active-tab mutations and before it assigns each tab position later in the hook. This binds the intended capture-before-body-position/layout ordering.

Capture stores computed transform by body. Reversal restart sets transition-property none, restores the captured transform, forces layout, then restores the state target if no newer lifecycle or consumer style supersedes it. Completion guards stale transitionend by a monotonic deadline and clears only owned transforms; transform/transition-property consumer overrides prevent restart.
Body-content transitions only transform using inherited duration; left/right states use +/-100% translate and hidden visibility. Active or animating content is visible.

rendered_style_observations.native_css: At A→B→A reversal under 700ms duration, both body transforms are at non-endpoint values immediately before retarget (-54.8797 px and +693.12 px for 748 px bodies) and remain unchanged at the synchronous selection/layout boundary (0 px delta). Final active A is centered and outgoing B is hidden/unattached; temporary package-owned inline body transforms are removed.
rendered_style_observations.content_width_boundary: During the separate same-pass active/inactive content-width swap, baseline widths change 716↔812 px with transform deltas 0/0 px. With only computed-transform storage disabled in the FESM, the same width change yields transform deltas 7.03/88.97 px. The two measurements are from separate baseline and mutant reports; the mutant was deliberately identified as a mutation.
rendered_style_observations.consumer_style: Actual body-content `transform: scale(.9)` and `transition-property: opacity` persist through a mid-transition A→B→A reversal. The implementation declines to override these consumer-owned styles; test also checks final lifecycle state.
rendered_style_observations.rtl_dynamic: RTL B entry starts at -748 px for 748 px wrapper. Dynamic-height case changes measured wrapper height 120→188 px and settles selected B.
rendered_style_observations.no_motion: 0ms duration and MATERIAL_ANIMATIONS animationsDisabled true each settle selected pane and emit one completion.
